# apple_app_clip_advanced_experience (Resource)

Creates an advanced App Clip experience: an App Clip card for one invocation URL, with its own header image, title and subtitle, and optionally a place on Apple Maps. The resource uploads the header image; a changed image file is uploaded as a new image. App Store Connect can't delete an advanced experience, so destroying the resource removes it, which deactivates it for good; an experience removed outside Terraform is created again. Import it by ID; the next apply then sets the configured image file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_clip_advanced_experience" "cafe" {
  app_clip_id       = data.apple_app_clips.app.app_clips[0].id
  link              = "https://example.com/order/cafe"
  action            = "OPEN"
  business_category = "FOOD_AND_DRINK"
  is_powered_by     = false
  header_image_file = "${path.module}/cafe.png"

  default_language = "EN"
  localizations = [
    { language = "EN", title = "Example Cafe", subtitle = "Order ahead and skip the line." },
    { language = "FR", title = "Café Exemple", subtitle = "Commandez à l'avance." },
  ]

  place = {
    names          = ["Example Cafe"]
    map_action     = "RESTAURANT_ORDER_FOOD"
    relationship   = "OWNER"
    home_page      = "https://example.com"
    street_address = ["1 Example Way"]
    locality       = "Cupertino"
    state_province = "CA"
    postal_code    = "95014"
    country_code   = "US"
    latitude       = 37.3349
    longitude      = -122.009
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_clip_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip; see `data.apple_app_clips`.
- `default_language` (String) Language of the card when none of `localizations` matches the person's language: `AR`, `CA`, `CS`, `DA`, `DE`, `EL`, `EN`, `ES`, `FI`, `FR`, `HE`, `HI`, `HR`, `HU`, `ID`, `IT`, `JA`, `KO`, `MS`, `NL`, `NO`, `PL`, `PT`, `RO`, `RU`, `SK`, `SV`, `TH`, `TR`, `UK`, `VI`, `ZH`. `localizations` must include it.
- `header_image_file` (String) Path of the card's header image. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.
- `is_powered_by` (Boolean) Whether a platform provider that serves several businesses submits the experience, for example an ordering service's App Clip on a restaurant's card.
- `link` (String) Invocation URL of the experience, e.g. `https://example.com/order/cafe`. Changing it creates a new experience.
- `localizations` (Attributes Set) Text of the card per language. A change replaces every localization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--localizations))

### Optional

- `action` (String) Verb on the App Clip card's button: `OPEN`, `VIEW`, `PLAY`.
- `business_category` (String) Category of the business: `AUTOMOTIVE`, `BEAUTY`, `BIKES`, `BOOKS`, `CASINO`, `EDUCATION`, `EDUCATION_JAPAN`, `ENTERTAINMENT`, `EV_CHARGER`, `FINANCIAL_USD`, `FINANCIAL_CNY`, `FINANCIAL_GBP`, `FINANCIAL_JPY`, `FINANCIAL_EUR`, `FITNESS`, `FOOD_AND_DRINK`, `GAS`, `GROCERY`, `HEALTH_AND_MEDICAL`, `HOTEL_AND_TRAVEL`, `MUSIC`, `PARKING`, `PET_SERVICES`, `PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES`, `SHOPPING`, `TICKETING`, `TRANSIT`.
- `place` (Attributes) Place on Apple Maps that the experience belongs to, which lets the App Clip appear on the place's card. Apple Maps matches the place after the experience is saved; `place_status` reports the result. Attributes left unset are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--place))

### Read-Only

- `header_image_checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the header image.
- `header_image_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the header image.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the advanced App Clip experience.
- `place_status` (String) Whether Apple Maps matched the place: `PENDING`, `MATCHED` or `NO_MATCH`. Null without a place.
- `status` (String) State of the experience: `RECEIVED`, `DEACTIVATED` or `APP_TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS`.

<a id="nestedatt--localizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `localizations`

Required:

- `language` (String) Language: one of the values of `default_language`.

Optional:

- `subtitle` (String) Subtitle on the card.
- `title` (String) Title on the card.


<a id="nestedatt--place"></a>
### Nested Schema for `place`

Optional:

- `categories` (List of String) Apple Maps categories of the place.
- `country_code` (String) Country code of the place, e.g. `US`.
- `display_point_source` (String) Where the point comes from: `CALCULATED`, `MANUALLY_PLACED`.
- `floor` (String) Floor of the place.
- `full_address` (String) Address of the place on one line.
- `home_page` (String) URL of the place's website.
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude of the point the place is shown at.
- `locality` (String) City or town of the place.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude of the point the place is shown at.
- `map_action` (String) Action the App Clip offers on the place's card, e.g. `RESTAURANT_ORDER_FOOD`, `BUY_TICKETS` or `PAY_TO_PARK`.
- `names` (List of String) Names of the place, e.g. `["Example Cafe"]`.
- `neighborhood` (String) Neighborhood of the place.
- `phone_intent` (String) What the phone number is for.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number of the place.
- `phone_type` (String) Kind of phone number: `FAX`, `LANDLINE`, `MOBILE`, `TOLLFREE`.
- `place_id` (String) Apple Maps ID of the place, when known.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal code of the place.
- `relationship` (String) How the developer relates to the place: `OWNER`, `AUTHORIZED`, `OTHER`.
- `state_province` (String) State or province of the place.
- `street_address` (List of String) Street address lines.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_clip_advanced_experience.cafe
  identity = {
    id = "5a7c9e1b-3d2f-4b6a-8c0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the advanced App Clip experience.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_clip_advanced_experience.cafe 5a7c9e1b-3d2f-4b6a-8c0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
```
